item.title: Version 0.2.17
item.description: Fix blank conversations after sending long pasted messages. Keep complete message text and replies visible, recover cached chat reopening, and return reliably to Latest messages after new replies arrive while reading history. Preserve reasoning/tool expansion and secure-input/approval visibility.

item.title: Version 0.2.16
item.description: Manage Hermes bots from Klaudimero: create profiles, configure each bot’s plugins, MCP servers and skills, and switch the bot for a new chat while preserving its draft. Improve native composer clearing and preserve newer drafts after uncertain or refused sends.

item.title: Version 0.2.15
item.description: Show recent chat replies immediately while earlier history loads. Optional context statistics no longer hold the composer or live refresh. Recover interrupted history reads and offer inline Retry without restarting the app. Native Mac loading and recovery verified; universal Developer ID release, notarized by Apple and signed for Sparkle updates. No server or plugin update is required.

item.title: Version 0.2.13
item.description: Fix assistant reply text cut off at the bottom on Mac. Match TextKit 2 measurement to the native selectable reply, including paragraph, list, table and image layout. Preserve complete reply selection and copying during window resizing and streamed updates. Developer ID signed, notarized and verified for Sparkle updates.

item.title: Version 0.2.12
item.description: Encrypted reply previews and account-scoped Mac activity with companion 0.6.0. Phone pushes pause while Klaudimero is active on Mac, then resume without replaying suppressed alerts. Native activation and last-window lifecycle handling; detect old loaded plugin implementations even if their version label appears current. Update the plugin for all bots and restart the Hermes dashboard and gateway. Signed, notarized and verified for Sparkle updates.

item.title: Version 0.2.11
item.description: Fix selection across complete Mac replies, including Markdown lists, paragraphs, code and tables. Keep selection intact during chat refreshes and window resizing.

item.title: Version 0.2.10
item.description: A native Mac Your Bots grid with main-chat previews, standard error alerts, and a focused text editor: Return sends, Shift-Return or Control-Return inserts a newline. Generated screenshot/image deliveries display as tappable previews in live and saved chats. Universal Developer ID release notarized by Apple, with a signed Sparkle update.

item.title: Version 0.2.9
item.description: Fixes a launch crash caused by the Sparkle framework search path in the native Mac app. The actual signed app and packaged DMG now resolve the embedded updater correctly on Apple Silicon and Intel. Signed and notarized. If 0.2.8 cannot open, install this replacement manually once; future updates can use Sparkle.

item.title: Version 0.2.8
item.description: Adds Sparkle automatic software updates to the native Mac app, Check for Updates in the application menu, and automatic-check/download controls in General settings. Updates use signed archives, sandboxed installation and notarized Developer ID releases. Install this updater-enabled build once manually; future Mac updates can install through Sparkle.

item.title: Version 0.2.7
item.description: Reconcile plugin0.5.0 proactivity delivery chats with encrypted notification previews. Update all bot installations, including older named bots when the default is current. Restart dashboard and relevant gateways after updating; relay and certificates unchanged. Native universal Mac, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description: Show actual signed and encrypted reply previews in notifications instead of generic verified event text. Adds metadata-only extension decryption status and verified foreground presentation. Requires plugin0.4.3 update and dashboard/gateway restart; relay and certificates unchanged. Native universal Mac, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description: Add confirmed gateway and verified systemd dashboard restart controls after plugin setup. Fix composer draft reappearing after an accepted prompt loses its acknowledgement; preserve newer drafts and restore only explicit refusals. Plugin0.4.2 pinned; existing0.4.1 needs one host-side dashboard restart to expose new restart controls. Universal native Mac, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description: Fix plugin updates refused by Hermes dependency approval. Plugin0.4.1 uses explicit consent and verifies installed commits; update errors remain visible and installed/loaded versions are separate. Existing0.3/0.4 plugins need the one-time exact command shown in Settings, then restart the dashboard and use Update for named bots. Relay0.3.0 is unchanged. Universal native Mac, Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: Version 0.2.3
item.description: Klaudimero is now a Hermes delivery channel for jobs and proactive bot messages. Update plugin in Settings to install reviewed plugin0.4.0 for all bots, then restart Hermes dashboard/gateways. Results appear in each bot’s main chat, with busy-chat retries and existing encrypted notifications. Relay0.3.0 stays compatible. Universal native Mac app, Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description: Automatic encrypted notification enrollment with plugin0.3.0; no relay settings or shared password on Hermes. Host-scoped grants, encrypted device verification and durable opt-out cleanup. Universal native Mac app, Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. The service operator deploys relay0.3.0 with the Apple key to enable real APNs delivery.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description: Native universal Mac release, signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple. App and DMG tickets are stapled and Gatekeeper accepts both. Includes the current Klaudimero interface and encrypted push support; push delivery requires the separately configured relay.

item.title: Version 0.1.17
item.description: Native universal macOS SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, built with the macOS 27 SDK. Dedicated desktop workspace with three-column Chats, native Bots and Jobs tables, Jobs inspector, standard Settings window and keyboard commands. Includes compact agent handoffs, reasoning and tools disclosures, secure input, guarded chat deletion and server-backed archive/restore. Internal build signed with Apple Development, published without notarization at the owner’s request; Gatekeeper does not accept this build automatically. Notarization remains tracked in GitHub issue #1.
